[package]
workspace = "../../../.."
name = "semio-hub-wfc"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "WFC plugin composition for the independently packaged bitmap, grid2d, wfc2d, grid3d, and wfc3d artifacts"

[lints]
workspace = true

[package.metadata.component]
package = "semio:wfc"

[package.metadata.semio]
deployment-directory = "🀄️wfc"
component-kind = "plugin"
role = "hub"

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "bitmap"
app = "s.wfc.bitmap@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["wfc bitmap"]
ports = { react = 6041, wgpu = 6141 }

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "grid2d"
app = "s.wfc.grid2d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["wfc 2d grid"]
ports = { react = 6042, wgpu = 6142 }

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "wfc2d"
app = "s.wfc.wfc2d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["wfc 2d"]
ports = { react = 6043, wgpu = 6143 }

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "grid3d"
app = "s.wfc.grid3d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["wfc 3d grid"]
ports = { react = 6044, wgpu = 6144 }

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "wfc3d"
app = "s.wfc.wfc3d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["wfc 3d"]
ports = { react = 6045, wgpu = 6145 }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[features]
# 🔌️ The WASM component entry point (`plugin_exports!` → `#[no_mangle]`
# `semio_plugin_install_bundle`). Default-on so this plugin builds as its own component, and
# switched OFF by any crate that EMBEDS it: two crates each exporting the same `#[no_mangle]` symbol
# is a duplicate-symbol link error, and the embedding crate is the one that must own the entry point.
default = ["plugin-entry"]
plugin-entry = []

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-s-artifact-wfc-2d = { workspace = true, features = ["component-app-assembly"] }
semio-s-artifact-wfc-3d = { workspace = true, features = ["component-app-assembly"] }
semio-s-artifact-wfc-bitmap = { workspace = true, features = ["component-app-assembly"] }
semio-s-artifact-wfc-grid2d = { workspace = true, features = ["component-app-assembly"] }
semio-s-artifact-wfc-grid3d = { workspace = true, features = ["component-app-assembly"] }
semio-framework-dispatch-macros = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-plugin = { workspace = true, features = ["component-guest"] }
# ⏯️ `dyn_enum_close!` copies `PluginApp::tool_run_trace_delta`'s signature verbatim into the generated
# impl HERE, so the domain-neutral tool-run types have to resolve in this crate too.
semio-framework-tool-run = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-plugin = { workspace = true, features = ["component-guest", "artifact-app-testing"] }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-async-macros = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }

# ⏱️ The guest-lifecycle boot deadline law runs from the crate's PUBLIC surface as its own `[[test]]`,
# independent of the lib test target, so a peer's in-flight editor/viewer refactor can never hide a
# first-step regression.
[[test]]
name = "boot_deadline"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🔬️boot-deadline/🦀️.rs"

# 🚪️ The instance close law for every wfc editor runs from the crate's PUBLIC surface as its own
# `[[test]]`, so a close-ladder regression can never hide behind the lib test target.
[[test]]
name = "close_ladder"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🚪️close-ladder/🦀️.rs"

# 😴️ The idle-turn authority (settled status + zero retention) runs from the crate's PUBLIC surface
# as its own `[[test]]` and installs its own `HeapWitness` global allocator, which no other test
# target may carry.
[[test]]
name = "idle_turns"
path = "../../🧪️tests/😴️idle-turns/🦀️.rs"

[package.metadata.semio.sources]
artifacts = ["../../../../../✏️s/🔌️plugins/🀄️wfc/🗿️artifacts"]

package = "semio:procedural"

[package.metadata.semio]
deployment-directory = "🌀️procedural"
component-kind = "plugin"
role = "hub"
consumes = ["forms.questionKind", "flow.extension"]
depends-on = [
  "flow-extension-bim",

semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true, optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-plugin = { workspace = true, features = ["component-guest", "artifact-app-testing"] }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-async-macros = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }

# ⏱️ The guest-lifecycle boot deadline law runs from the crate's PUBLIC surface as its own `[[test]]`,
# independent of the lib test target, so a peer's in-flight editor/viewer refactor can never hide a
# first-step regression.
[[test]]
name = "boot_deadline"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🔬️boot-deadline/🦀️.rs"

# 🚪️ The instance close law for both procedural editors runs from the crate's PUBLIC surface as its
# own `[[test]]`, so a close-ladder regression can never hide behind the lib test target.
[[test]]
name = "close_ladder"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🚪️close-ladder/🦀️.rs"

# as its own `[[test]]` and installs its own `HeapWitness` global allocator, which no other test
# target may carry.
[[test]]
name = "idle_turns"
path = "../../🧪️tests/😴️idle-turns/🦀️.rs"

artifacts = ["../../../../../✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌀️procedural/🗿️artifacts"]

[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-s-plugin-cad-aec-building"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "CAD aec-building extension — contributes building STEP import profile to cad-play"

[lints]
workspace = true

[package.metadata.component]
package = "semio:cad-extension-aec-building"

[package.metadata.semio]
deployment-directory = "🏢️cad-extension-aec-building"
component-kind = "extension"
role = "extension"
extends = "cad"
contributes = ["cad.computer"]

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.dev]
wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-ui-locale = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🌐️locale/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-s-artifact-cad-cad = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-plugin = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/📦️packages/🦀️rust", features = ["component-guest"], package = "semio-framework-plugin" }
semio-framework = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework" }
# 🏢️ Names cad's `CadSnapshot`/`CadMutation`/leaf-mutation dispatch types so this extension can
# plan a composite mutation through cad's own `Planner` — WASM component entry point stays off (this
# crate owns its own `extension_exports!` entry point; two `#[no_mangle]` bundle-install symbols in
# one component is a link error), mirroring `💠️lowpoly`'s `cad_plugin` dependency.
# 🏢️ Supplies the `protocol`/`store` crate-alias targets (`CompositeMutationKind`/`Planner`/
# `ArtifactPack`) every plugin/extension crate aliases locally in its own glue — see cad's own
# `🦀️.rs` `extern crate semio_framework_os_kernel as protocol/store` lines.
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
# 🌱️ `#[derive(ToValue, FromValue)]` — `CreateBuildingStorey`/`BuildingStructureSummary` satisfy
# `CompositeMutationKind`'s supertrait bound this way, not `serde::Serialize`/`DeserializeOwned`.
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }
# 🌱️ `pack::json::Value` — first-party `serde_json::Value` replacement for the `computersJson`
# payload; `contributes_topic` now also speaks `DslValue` end to end, so `serde`/`serde_json` are
# fully gone from this crate.
pack = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack" }

[dev-dependencies]
serde.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

pack = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack" }
